questions.text: Which of the following may be true?

options.text: Both A and D

questions.explanation:
Students: A, B, C, D, P, Q, R and S

I. S gets more than Q and gets 30 chocolates, which is 10 more than B.

S = B + 10

30 = B + 10

B = 20

II. D gets 5 chocolates more than B, who does not get the lowest number of chocolates.

D=B+5

D=20+5

D = 25

III. Only two people get chocolate lower than D. A gets more than D but less than C.

> D (25)> B (20)> Q

IV. P gets less than C and more than S.

> P > S (30)> D (25)> B (20)> Q

V. A gets more than D but less than C. R gets more than A and does not get the highest chocolate

C(60) > R(55) > A (50)> P(40) > S (30)> D (25)> B (20)> Q(15).

Hence, correct option is Both A and D.
